stop_condition: a query filter is rejected or ignored

warning.message: The itemEndDate filter value is invalid. For the valid values, refer to the API call documentation.

first_query.action: QueryRejected raised; discovery aborted before any persistence

root_cause: eBay refuses an itemEndDate range whose start is not sufficiently in the future. The authorized T0..T0+24h window starts at the moment of the request and is rejected outright.
retroactive_explanation: This closes the previously unexplained result from the 2026-08-02 17:24 probe. That probe also used a start-at-now window, so its itemEndDate filter was rejected the same way and the query ran unfiltered - which is exactly why its total (2,430,520) matched the unfiltered baseline (2,429,379) and why endingSoonest returned items ending seconds later. Its warnings array, which was discarded in-process, would have said so.
proven_acceptable_window: start = now + 12h, end = now + 36h (verified 2026-08-02T17:28:46Z, total 333,296, all ten items ending at exactly +12.00h)

defect_fixed.why: a doomed window is now refused locally instead of spending a request and relying on the warnings array being read

coverage_claim: No bands were queried, so this pilot establishes nothing about the auction market.
